opening_message: Hi, I want to enroll my 4-year-old daughter in jiu-jitsu classes.
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a parent enrolling your 4-year-old daughter Maya in Jiu-Jitsu. Your DOB: 1988-06-15. Email: {{email}}. Phone: {{phone}}.

Behavior rules:
- The class is for your child only (not for you).
- When asked who the class is for, say it's for your daughter.
- When asked for your name (the parent), give {{firstName}} {{lastName}}.
- When asked for your DOB, give: June 15, 1988.
- When asked for your email, give {{email}}.
- When asked for your phone, give {{phone}}.
- When asked for the child's name, say Maya.
- When asked for Maya's date of birth, say: March 8, 2022 (making her 4 years old).
- When asked which discipline, say Jiu-Jitsu.
- When offered appointment slots, pick the first one.
- Once the bot confirms the booking, reply with [END].
